bar.text: ...SMALL CRAFT ADVISORY IN EFFECT THROUGH SATURDAY MORNING... Combined seas 10 to 13 ft building to 13 to 15 feet by Friday afternoon. Bar conditions rough becoming severe by Friday afternoon. Maximum ebb currents will occur around 200 AM Friday, 230 PM Friday, 245 AM Saturday. The afternoon ebb on Friday will be strong.
